title.narrative: Improving Governance and Public Sector Efficiency Program (Subprogram 2)

description.narrative: The program aims to strengthen governance in the public sector and the diversification of the economy by introducing rule-based fiscal planning in the budget systems of the Government of Azerbaijan, reforming the legal and institutional structures of state-owned enterprises (SOEs), and helping improve the business environment and access to finance for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). This is the second of two subprograms included in the programmatic approach that was approved in November 2017.
